hookups.source: https://www.ncagr.gov/divisions/ncstatefair/campground ('Water, sewer and electrical access is available at each site at the N.C. State Fair Campground, (electricity access ranges from 30 - 50 amps)'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.ncagr.gov/divisions/ncstatefair/campground ('There are 101 sites at the N.C. State Fair Campground, and 150 sites on the main campus'; the intro says '100 full-hookup sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Dump station open to non-campers for $10 (pay Public Safety).

facilities.source: https://www.ncagr.gov/divisions/ncstatefair/campground ('Pets are not allowed in showers and restrooms', 'For use of dump station without an overnight stay ... Cost for use is $10', 'Free Wi-Fi.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Open all year except October, when it closes for the N.C. State Fair.

season.source: https://www.ncagr.gov/divisions/ncstatefair/campground ('the campground is open year-round with the exception of the month of October when it closes for the N.C. State Fair'; 'The N.C. State Fair Campground is CLOSED to the public for the month of October'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book on the Fairgrounds' Firefly Reservations page, up to 180 days out; 'Do not pull into a campsite prior to having a reservation secured.' Check-in 3 p.m., check-out noon; credit card only. Stays of 14 nights or less, 'no exceptions'. The 150 first-come sites on the main campus are for show participants and vendors, not this campground.

booking.source: https://www.ncagr.gov/divisions/ncstatefair/campground ('Visit the Firefly Reservation Site', 'Reservations are available 180-days out', 'Do not pull into a campsite prior to having a reservation secured', 'visits of 14 nights or less, no exceptions'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: $45/night for arrivals on or after 2026-01-01 ($35 in 2025); $3.50/night non-refundable reservation fee.

fees.source: https://www.ncagr.gov/divisions/ncstatefair/campground ('Camping rates are now $45 per night for all reservations with arrival dates on or after January 1, 2026'; 'the $3.50 per night, non-refundable reservation fee'), read 2026-10-22

note: N.C. Department of Agriculture's campground at the State Fairgrounds on Youth Center Dr in Raleigh, beside I-40 near NC State and the PNC Arena. RV camping only, no tents. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 101 full-hookup sites (30-50 amp), $45 (2026) plus $3.50/night reservation fee, 14-night maximum. Changed season year-round -> closed in October (11-01 to 09-30). Added showers, dump, free Wi-Fi, Firefly booking 180 days out, no walk-ins. Note: dropped the incorrect 'open to the public year round' and the field facts. Not stated: site lengths, pull-throughs.
flags: Phone 919-612-6767 is the Fairgrounds' 24-hour Public Safety line, the only number the campground page gives for it (division office 919-821-7400).
